outcome: Emergency room visits within 30 days following childbirth
Risk factors for emergency room visits
cohort: 28,963 women in Stockholm County, Sweden, who gave birth in 2013
finding: Emergency room visits following childbirth were most common immediately following discharge, and caesarean section, assisted birth, and sphincter injury were significant risk factors for emergency room visits.
mod_finding: Caesarean section and assisted birth were associated with an increased risk of emergency room visits, suggesting a need for improved early support for women with childbirth complications.
